summary.text: Anthony Broadman is a Democratic member of the Oregon State Senate representing District 27, which his legislative page says includes Bend, Sisters, Redmond, Black Butte, Eagle Crest, Tumalo and most of Deschutes County.

paragraphs.text: Before joining the State Senate, Broadman served on the Bend City Council from 2020 to 2024, including a term as Mayor Pro Tem in 2022.
As an attorney, he says he has dedicated his career to advocating for Tribal governments and small businesses, and he served as Chief Judge of the Warm Springs Court of Appeals.
His biography names creating economic opportunities, addressing affordable housing and enhancing public safety among the issues that matter most to him.
